title: Writing The Physics of Angels with Matthew Fox

tellings.quote: we chose the most interesting passages in in their books about angels the most relevant ones and then we discussed each short passage as a dialogue and that's what the book is really

plain: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake says he wrote the book The Physics of Angels together with the theologian Matthew Fox by picking the most interesting passages about angels from old Christian writers, Dionysius the Areopagite, Thomas Aquinas and Hildegard of Bingen, and then discussing each short passage as a dialogue between the two of them. Sheldrake tells Michels this as the book's co-author: "that's what the book is really." It is his account of how a scientist came to take medieval writing about angels seriously.
